cards.definition: Hiding an object’s internal state behind a public interface.
cards.example: A Transform exposes SetPosition() instead of raw matrix fields.

zh-Hans.definition: 将对象内部状态隐藏在公共接口之后。

cards.definition: A class derives behaviour and data from a base class; deep hierarchies get brittle in engines.
cards.example: class Enemy : public Actor.

zh-Hans.definition: 类从基类继承行为和数据；引擎中深层继承体系容易变得脆弱。

cards.definition: Building objects out of smaller parts (“has-a”) rather than inheritance (“is-a”).
cards.example: An entity holds Render, Physics and Audio components.

zh-Hans.definition: 用更小的部件（“拥有”）构建对象，而非继承（“是一个”）。

cards.definition: Reusable named solution to a recurring design problem (Singleton, Iterator, Abstract Factory…).
cards.example: An Iterator walks a container without exposing its layout.

zh-Hans.definition: 针对反复出现的设计问题的可复用命名方案（单例、迭代器、抽象工厂等）。

cards.definition: C++11 feature that transfers resources from a temporary instead of copying them.
cards.example: std::move(buffer) hands over the heap allocation.

zh-Hans.definition: C++11 特性：从临时对象转移资源而非复制。

cards.definition: Debug-time check that stops the program when an assumption is false; compiled out in release.
cards.example: assert(index < size);

zh-Hans.definition: 假设不成立时终止程序的调试期检查；发布版中被移除。

cards.definition: Standard signed-integer encoding: negate by inverting bits and adding one.
cards.example: −1 in 8 bits is 0xFF.

zh-Hans.definition: 标准有符号整数编码：取反加一即得相反数。

cards.definition: Byte order of multi-byte values: little-endian stores the least significant byte first.

zh-Hans.definition: 多字节值的字节顺序：小端序先存最低有效字节。

cards.definition: Sign, biased exponent and mantissa; 32-bit floats bias the exponent by 127.

zh-Hans.definition: 由符号位、偏置指数和尾数组成；32 位浮点的指数偏置为 127。

cards.definition: Smallest ε with 1 + ε ≠ 1 in a floating-point type; about 1.19e-7 for float.
cards.example: Large world coordinates lose precision.

zh-Hans.definition: 使 1 + ε ≠ 1 的最小 ε；float 约为 1.19e-7。

cards.definition: Unit in the last place: the gap between adjacent representable floats at a value.
cards.example: At 2²⁴, one ULP of a float is 2.

zh-Hans.definition: 某数值处相邻可表示浮点数之间的间隔。

cards.definition: Float smaller than the smallest normal value, losing precision gradually; can be slow on some CPUs.
cards.example: Values near 1e-40 in float.

zh-Hans.definition: 小于最小规格化值的浮点数，精度逐渐下降；在部分 CPU 上较慢。

cards.definition: Representing fractions with an integer and an implied binary point.
cards.example: 16.16 fixed-point for deterministic physics.

zh-Hans.definition: 用整数和隐含的二进制小数点表示小数。

cards.definition: Text (code), data (initialised globals), BSS (zero-initialised) and read-only data.
cards.example: static int counter; lives in BSS.

zh-Hans.definition: 代码段、数据段（已初始化全局变量）、BSS（零初始化）和只读数据段。

cards.definition: Linker errors for a declared-but-never-defined symbol, or one defined in two translation units.
cards.example: Defining a function in a header without inline.

zh-Hans.term: 未解析 / 重复定义符号
zh-Hans.definition: 链接错误：符号已声明但未定义，或在两个编译单元中重复定义。

cards.definition: Placing data at addresses that are multiples of its size so the CPU can load it efficiently.
cards.example: A float should sit on a 4-byte boundary.

zh-Hans.definition: 将数据放在其大小倍数的地址上，以便 CPU 高效加载。

cards.definition: Arithmetic logic unit: CPU part that performs integer arithmetic and bitwise operations.
cards.example: ADD and AND execute in the ALU.

zh-Hans.definition: 执行整数运算和位运算的 CPU 部件。

cards.definition: Floating-point unit for float/double maths.
cards.example: Float multiplies run on the FPU or vector unit.

zh-Hans.definition: 执行浮点运算的部件。

cards.definition: Tiny, fastest storage inside the CPU (instruction pointer, stack pointer, general purpose).
cards.example: The IP holds the address of the next instruction.

zh-Hans.definition: CPU 内部最小最快的存储（指令指针、栈指针、通用寄存器）。

cards.definition: How an instruction finds its operand: immediate, register, direct, register-indirect, indexed.
cards.example: mov eax, [ebx+8] is register-indirect with offset.

zh-Hans.definition: 指令取得操作数的方式：立即数、寄存器、直接、寄存器间接、变址。

cards.definition: Application binary interface: calling conventions, register use and data layout that compiled code must agree on.
cards.example: Mixing compilers with different ABIs breaks linking.

zh-Hans.definition: 编译代码须遵守的调用约定、寄存器使用和数据布局。

cards.definition: Requested data is not in cache and must be fetched from a slower level, costing hundreds of cycles from RAM.
cards.example: Pointer-chasing a linked list misses constantly.

zh-Hans.definition: 所需数据不在缓存中，须从较慢层级获取；从内存取需数百周期。

cards.definition: Write-back updates memory only on eviction; write-through writes memory on every store.
cards.example: Most CPU data caches are write-back.

zh-Hans.definition: 写回仅在淘汰时更新内存；写直达在每次存储时都写内存。

cards.definition: Protocol keeping per-core caches consistent; lines are Modified, Exclusive, Shared or Invalid.
cards.example: A write on core 1 invalidates the line on core 2.

zh-Hans.definition: 保持各核缓存一致的协议；缓存行处于修改、独占、共享或无效状态。

cards.definition: Threads write different variables on the same cache line, forcing coherency traffic.
cards.example: Two counters in one 64-byte line slow both threads.

zh-Hans.definition: 多线程写同一缓存行中的不同变量，引发一致性流量。

cards.definition: Non-uniform memory access: each CPU has faster local memory and slower remote memory.
cards.example: Pin threads near the memory they use.

zh-Hans.definition: 每个 CPU 访问本地内存较快、远程内存较慢。

cards.definition: Device registers appear at memory addresses, so loads/stores talk to hardware.
cards.example: Writing to a GPU register address.

zh-Hans.definition: 设备寄存器映射到内存地址，读写即与硬件通信。

cards.definition: Organising data for cache-friendly, linear access (e.g. struct-of-arrays) instead of object graphs.
cards.example: Store all particle positions contiguously.

zh-Hans.definition: 为缓存友好的线性访问组织数据（如数组结构体），而非对象图。

cards.definition: Concurrency: multiple flows of control interleave; parallelism: they truly run at the same time.
cards.example: Two threads on one core are concurrent but not parallel.

zh-Hans.definition: 并发：多个控制流交错执行；并行：真正同时运行。

cards.definition: Classifies machines by instruction and data streams: SISD, SIMD, MISD, MIMD.
cards.example: A GPU is SIMD/SIMT; a multicore CPU is MIMD.

zh-Hans.definition: 按指令流与数据流对计算机分类：SISD、SIMD、MISD、MIMD。

cards.definition: Single instruction, multiple data: one instruction processes a vector of values.
cards.example: SSE adds four floats at once.

zh-Hans.definition: 一条指令同时处理一组数值。

cards.definition: Task: different work in parallel; data: the same work on different data.
cards.example: Audio and physics threads vs. skinning 1,000 meshes.

zh-Hans.definition: 任务并行：不同工作并行；数据并行：对不同数据执行相同工作。

cards.definition: Overlapping the stages of successive instructions to raise throughput.
cards.example: Fetch the next instruction while executing this one.

zh-Hans.definition: 重叠连续指令的各阶段以提高吞吐量。

cards.definition: Issues more than one instruction per cycle using multiple execution units.
cards.example: Two integer ALUs run independent adds together.

zh-Hans.definition: 利用多个执行单元每周期发射多条指令。

cards.definition: CPU reorders independent instructions to keep units busy while preserving single-thread results.
cards.example: A load waits; later independent adds run first.

zh-Hans.definition: CPU 重排独立指令以保持单元忙碌，同时保证单线程结果不变。

cards.definition: Very long instruction word: the compiler packs parallel operations into one wide instruction.
cards.example: Some DSPs and older consoles.

zh-Hans.definition: 由编译器将并行操作打包进一条很宽的指令。

cards.definition: RISC: few simple fixed-size instructions; CISC: many complex, variable-length ones.
cards.example: ARM is RISC; x86 is CISC.

zh-Hans.definition: RISC：少量简单定长指令；CISC：大量复杂变长指令。

cards.definition: Identical cores share memory and the OS schedules threads on any of them.
cards.example: A PC with 8 identical cores.

zh-Hans.definition: 相同的核心共享内存，操作系统可将线程调度到任一核心。

cards.definition: Cores differ in role or design; e.g. a master core plus specialised workers.
cards.example: PS3 Cell: one PPU and several SPUs.

zh-Hans.definition: 核心角色或设计不同，如一个主核加若干专用核。

cards.definition: One physical core runs two hardware threads, sharing execution units.
cards.example: 8 cores show as 16 logical CPUs.

zh-Hans.definition: 一个物理核心运行两个硬件线程，共享执行单元。

cards.definition: The OS interrupts threads on a timer and switches between them without their cooperation.
cards.example: A busy loop cannot freeze the whole system.

zh-Hans.definition: 操作系统通过定时器中断线程并切换，无需线程配合。

cards.definition: Running, runnable (ready) or blocked; the scheduler moves threads between them.
cards.example: A thread waiting on a mutex is blocked.

zh-Hans.definition: 运行、可运行（就绪）或阻塞；调度器在其间切换线程。

cards.definition: User-space execution context switched cooperatively by the program, not the OS.
cards.example: A job system yields fibers instead of blocking threads.

zh-Hans.definition: 由程序（而非操作系统）协作式切换的用户态执行上下文。

cards.definition: Restricting a thread to run on specific cores.
cards.example: Pin the render thread to core 1.

zh-Hans.definition: 限定线程只在特定核心上运行。

cards.definition: Address space layout randomisation: loads code and data at random addresses to hinder exploits.
cards.example: Pointers differ between runs.

zh-Hans.definition: 将代码和数据加载到随机地址以阻碍攻击。

cards.definition: Standard C threading API: create, join, mutexes, condition variables.
cards.example: pthread_create(&t, NULL, worker, arg);

zh-Hans.definition: 标准 C 线程 API：创建、汇合、互斥锁、条件变量。

cards.definition: Unsynchronised accesses to the same memory by two threads, at least one a write; undefined behaviour in C++.
cards.example: Two threads ++count without a lock.

zh-Hans.definition: 两个线程未同步地访问同一内存且至少一个是写；在 C++ 中为未定义行为。

cards.definition: Code that must execute atomically with respect to other threads touching the same data.
cards.example: Updating head and tail of a shared queue.

zh-Hans.definition: 相对于访问同一数据的其他线程必须原子执行的代码。

cards.definition: Bug that disappears or changes when you try to observe it, typical of races.
cards.example: Adding a printf hides the crash.

zh-Hans.definition: 观察时消失或改变的 bug，常见于竞态。

cards.definition: Threads share data by sending messages instead of sharing memory.
cards.example: Jobs post results to a queue owned by the main thread.

zh-Hans.definition: 线程通过发送消息而非共享内存来共享数据。

cards.definition: Each operation appears to take effect instantly at one point between its start and end.
cards.example: A lock-protected push is linearizable.

zh-Hans.definition: 每个操作看似在开始与结束之间的某一瞬间生效。

cards.definition: Lock that lets only one thread at a time into a critical section; blocked threads sleep.
cards.example: std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m);

zh-Hans.definition: 同一时间只允许一个线程进入临界区的锁；被阻塞线程休眠。

cards.definition: Counter allowing up to N threads in; binary semaphore behaves like a lock.
cards.example: Limit concurrent asset loads to 4.

zh-Hans.definition: 允许最多 N 个线程进入的计数器；二元信号量类似锁。

cards.definition: Lets a thread sleep until another signals a condition; must be used with a mutex and can wake spuriously.
cards.example: Worker waits until the job queue is non-empty.

zh-Hans.definition: 让线程休眠直到另一线程发出条件信号；须配合互斥锁，可能被虚假唤醒。

cards.definition: Linux “fast userspace mutex”: uncontended locking stays in user space, contended waits use the kernel.
cards.example: std::mutex on Linux is built on futexes.

zh-Hans.definition: Linux 机制：无竞争时在用户态加锁，有竞争时才进入内核等待。

cards.definition: Spinning in a loop checking a condition instead of sleeping.
cards.example: while (!ready) {}

zh-Hans.definition: 循环检查条件而不休眠。

cards.definition: Threads wait on each other forever; requires mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no preemption and circular wait (Coffman conditions).
cards.example: Thread A locks X then Y, B locks Y then X.

zh-Hans.definition: 线程相互永久等待；需满足互斥、持有并等待、不可抢占、循环等待（Coffman 条件）。

cards.definition: Threads keep reacting to each other and changing state but make no progress.
cards.example: Two threads back off and retry in lockstep forever.

zh-Hans.definition: 线程不断相互响应并改变状态，但毫无进展。

cards.definition: A high-priority thread waits on a lock held by a low-priority one that cannot run.
cards.example: Fixed by priority inheritance.

zh-Hans.definition: 高优先级线程等待低优先级线程持有的锁，而后者无法运行。

cards.definition: Classic problem showing deadlock when each philosopher grabs one fork and waits for the other.
cards.example: Solved by a global fork order.

zh-Hans.definition: 经典问题：每人拿起一把叉子等待另一把即导致死锁。

cards.definition: Always acquire locks in one agreed order to break circular wait.
cards.example: Lock by ascending address.

zh-Hans.definition: 始终按约定顺序获取锁以打破循环等待。

cards.definition: A lock the same thread may acquire again without deadlocking itself.
cards.example: A recursive function locking the same mutex.

zh-Hans.definition: 同一线程可再次获取而不会自我死锁的锁。

cards.definition: Threads frequently competing for the same lock, serialising work.
cards.example: One global allocator lock bottlenecks all workers.

zh-Hans.definition: 多线程频繁争抢同一把锁，导致工作串行化。

cards.definition: Instruction that reads, modifies and writes a value indivisibly (TAS, exchange, CAS, fetch-add).
cards.example: std::atomic<int>::fetch_add(1).

zh-Hans.definition: 不可分割地读取、修改并写回值的指令（TAS、交换、CAS、fetch-add）。

cards.definition: Atomically replace a value only if it still equals the expected one; returns success.
cards.example: Lock-free stack push loops on CAS of the head.

zh-Hans.definition: 仅当值仍等于预期值时原子替换，并返回是否成功。

cards.definition: Load-linked / store-conditional: the store fails if the location changed since the load; immune to ABA.
cards.example: ARM and PowerPC provide LL/SC.

zh-Hans.definition: 若加载后该位置被修改则条件存储失败；不受 ABA 影响。

cards.definition: A value changes A→B→A between read and CAS, so CAS wrongly succeeds.
cards.example: A freed and reused node looks unchanged.

zh-Hans.definition: 值在读取与 CAS 之间经历 A→B→A，使 CAS 错误地成功。

cards.definition: Lock-free: some thread always makes progress; wait-free: every thread finishes in bounded steps.
cards.example: A CAS-based queue is lock-free.

zh-Hans.definition: 无锁：总有线程取得进展；无等待：每个线程都在有限步内完成。

cards.definition: Instruction preventing the CPU/compiler from reordering memory operations across it.
cards.example: A full fence between publishing data and setting a flag.

zh-Hans.definition: 阻止 CPU/编译器跨越它重排内存操作的指令。

cards.definition: Acquire: later accesses cannot move before it; release: earlier accesses cannot move after it.
cards.example: Unlock = release, lock = acquire.

zh-Hans.definition: 获取：之后的访问不能移到其前；释放：之前的访问不能移到其后。

cards.definition: Stops the compiler (not the CPU) from reordering memory accesses.
cards.example: asm volatile("" ::: "memory").

zh-Hans.definition: 仅阻止编译器（而非 CPU）重排内存访问。

cards.definition: C++11 type providing atomic operations with selectable memory_order.
cards.example: std::atomic<bool> ready{false};

zh-Hans.definition: C++11 类型，提供可选内存序的原子操作。

cards.definition: Lock acquired by spinning on an atomic flag; good for very short critical sections.
cards.example: while (flag.test_and_set(acquire)) {}

zh-Hans.definition: 通过自旋原子标志获取的锁；适合极短的临界区。

cards.definition: Lock acquired in a constructor and released in a destructor, so it cannot be forgotten.
cards.example: std::scoped_lock guard(m);

zh-Hans.definition: 在构造函数中加锁、析构函数中解锁，避免遗忘释放。

cards.definition: Allows many concurrent readers or one writer.
cards.example: Many threads read the asset table; one loads new assets.

zh-Hans.definition: 允许多个读者并发或单个写者独占。

cards.definition: Readers access data without locks; writers publish a new copy and free the old one later.
cards.example: Updating a config table read every frame.

zh-Hans.definition: 读者无锁访问；写者发布新副本，稍后释放旧副本。

cards.definition: Writer bumps a sequence counter; readers retry if it changed or is odd during their read.
cards.example: Reading a frequently updated timestamp pair.

zh-Hans.definition: 写者递增序列号；若读取期间序列号变化或为奇数，读者重试。
